issues.description: Problem statement DD task 6 says `dd_get_amplitude` should "return the probability ... as a float", but both template and solution define `dd_get_amplitude` as returning a complex amplitude (`np.complex128`). This creates an API/expectation mismatch for students (amplitude vs probability and complex vs float).
issues.suggestedFix: Minimal fix: update the problem statement to say `dd_get_amplitude` returns the complex amplitude (`np.complex128`). If probability is intended, rename the function everywhere (problem/template/solution/tests) to `dd_get_probability` and return `float(abs(amplitude)**2)`.
